referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the entire transport life cycle. For rail infrastructure, expenditures and environmental interventions due to construction, renewal and disposal of railway tracks have been allocated based on the Gross tonne kilometre performance of freight transport on SBB railway tracks in 2014 ( 20260 Mio. Gtkm). Expenditures due to operation of the rail infrastructure, as well as land use have been allocated based on the yearly train kilometre performance (8615 Mio tkm). For the operation of goods transportation average data for freigth transport by rail in Switzerland were used. The data has been determined top down, by combining the total yearly energy consumption and the yearly tkm-performance of goods transportation. Electricity consumption has been updated based on SBB data for the year 2019.; UUID: d78d71e3-e455-3377-8606-599681966753
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the energy consumption of a goods train in Switzerland using electro energy only (no shunting processes are accounted for). In addition also the production and maintenance of vehicles as well as the construction and maintenance of the rail way tracks are accounted for.
